Commentary.Commentary: We are back for the chase! The players are walking out to the middle. Alex Hales and Philip Salt are the two openers for England. Pakistan going with spin straightaway as Mohammad Nawaz is ready to start proccedings with the ball. Here we go...
... THE RUN CHASE ...

Right then, Pakistan have posted a good total on the board and they have enough firepower to defend. However, they are without Haris Rauf and England will be looking to put more pressure on the other bowlers. They have the depth in theri batting but need to perform better than the previous two games. Will they be able to do it and level the series 3-3? Or will Pakistan defend again and seal the series? We will find out soon. Stay tuned for the second essay.

Sam Curran is up for a chat. He says its been a good series and his first time in Pakistan so it is amazing playing in front of the crowd. Mentions that hopefully they can win the match and make it 3-3. Claims that the outfield is getting a bit wet and it will be an interesting chase. Claims that Pakistan finished well but it got difficult to bowl towards the end as the ball was wet. Adds that hopefully it will get tougher for them. Says it is hot and shows that he is dripping with sweat

England, on the other started off well restricting the batters and picking up early wickets but they lost their way a bit in the middle overs when teh partnerships were building. However they pulled things back a bit at the death overs and restricted their opposition below 175. Sam Curran was the pick of the bowlers with two wickets and conceded just 26 runs. David Willey and Richard Gleeson contributed with one each. Adil Rashid was once again expensive and failed to get the breakthroughs which is a concern for them. Now it is up to their batters to chase it down which they haven't been able to in the last two games.

Pakistan will be happy with their batting effort. They started slowly to assess the pitch and were struggling to find the timing. However, once Babar Azam found his touch he never looked back from there. They lost Haris Rauf and Shan Masood for cheap scores as they showed some glimpses of his quality but he too fell. After that Babar Azam and Iftikhar Ahmed added 48 runs in which the latter scored 31 off just 21 balls before getting out. Babar Azam then changed his gears and also got to 3000 T20I runs (in 81 innings) which is the joint-highest with Virat Kohli. He remained unbeaten on 87 off 59 balls. At the start of the game, Babar Azam said that 150-160 would be a good total but they have gone past that and will be looking to defend well once again.

A brilliant innings from Babar Azam and 19 runs from the last over have helped Pakistan post a decent total of 169 runs. England will be disappointed and they will have to bat really well to chase this total down.

OUT! CAUGHT! Reece Topley claims a wicket on his last delivery but this has been a wonderful over for Pakistan! Reece Topley bowls this full and outside off, but releases the ball from the back of his hand. Mohammad Nawaz is early into the shot and hit this aerially towards long off where Harry Brook takes a easy catch. 19 runs have come from the last over though and Pakistan will be happy with the finish.
Commentary.Howout: c Harry Brook b Reece Topley

Commentary.Commentary: SIX! Mohammad Nawaz joins the party! Reece Topley misses his yorker once again and bowls a low full toss outside off, Mohammad Nawaz heaves this over deep mid-wicket for a maximum. This is a very good over for Pakistan.

Reece Topley bowls this on a yorker length and follows the batter to the leg side. Babar Azam misses his flick and gets hit on the pads. They take a leg bye as the ball rolls to the off side and Babar Azam is furious with himself.

This lands safely and Pakistan gets two more runs to their total. Reece Topley bangs this in short and outside off, Babar Azam looks to pull but only manages to get a top edge that flies over backward point. The ball lands in the vacant area just before the boundary and they take two runs.
SIX! This is sheer power! Reece Topley bowls this full and in line with the stumps as he misses the yorker. Babar Azam gets his front foot out of the way and thumps this over long on for a biggie.

FOUR! Babar Azam starts the final over boundary! Reece Topley bowls this on a good length and just outside off, Babar Azam walks across to the off side and pulls this to the right of the short fine leg boundary for four runs.
Reece Topley (3-0-13-0) to bowl the last over.
Sam Curran bowls a well-directed bouncer in line with the stumps, Mohammad Nawaz decides to duck under this one and let it through to the keeper.
Strays on the pad on a fuller length, Babar Azam misses his flick and the ball goes off the pads towards fine leg for a leg bye.

FOUR! Babar Azam picks the slower ball to perfection! Sam Curran bowls this slightly short and just outside off, Babar Azam waits on the ball and slaps this away to the deep mid-wicket fence for a useful boundary.
Goes a fraction full this time and outside off, Mohammad Nawaz knocks this to long off for a run.
This is short as well and angled into the batter. Mohammad Nawaz pulls this in the gap at mid-wicket and some good fielding restricts them to a brace.
Sam Curran bowls this back of a length and outside off, Babar Azam miscues his pull towards long on for a single.
Sam Curran to bowl the penultimate over. 18 runs from his 3 overs and 2 wickets.
Bowls this quick and into the batter on a shorter length, Mohammad Nawaz miscues his pull towards deep square leg and takes a couple of runs to end the over.

Bowls this on a good length as well and follows the batter to the leg side as he looks to make room. Babar Azam takes a wild swing but gets an inside edge onto his pads that runs towards third man. They take a run.
Angles this into the batter on a good length, Mohammad Nawaz taps this towards long on and takes one.
This is on a good length and in line with the stumps, Babar Azam works this down to long on for a single.
Full again and on leg, Babar Azam gets cramped and misses his flick as the ball goes through to the keeper.
Reece Topley begins with a full delivery, outside off, Babar Azam reaches for it and loses his grip to drive it straight to extra covers.
Mohammad Nawaz walks out to bat now. Also, Reece Topley comes back into he attack. He conceded just 8 runs in his first two overs.

OUT! CAUGHT! The short ball ploy finally pays off! David Willey bowls this really short and way outside the off pole, Asif Ali reaches for it and looks to slap this over the off side boundary. He does not get a good connection on the ball and it flies into the massive palms of Reece Topley at deep point. Asif Ali is unable to help Pakistan end strong as he has to make his way back to the pavillion. Pakistan have lost their fifth wicket now.
Commentary.Howout: c Reece Topley b David Willey

Commentary.Commentary: This is wide outside off on a shorter length, Asif Ali looks to slash at this but is beaten.
Bangs this in short and outside off, Asif Ali does not have his eyes on the ball and ducks just to be safe.
Bowls this back of a length and outside off, Babar Azam mistimes his shot back down the wicket past the bowler for a single to straightish long off.

SIX! That is an extraordinary shot! David Willey misses his yorker and bowls a low full toss outside the off pole, Babar Azam thumps this over the deep cover boundary for a maximum. Makes this shot look so easy.
David Willey bowls a full toss in line with the stumps, Babar Azam pulls this towards deep backward square leg where Sam Curran does well to keep them down to two.
David Willey (3-0-23-1) is back on.
Back to bowling on a good length and in line with the stumps, Babar Azam tucks this to deep backward square leg and takes a single to keep strike.
Goes fuller this time and outside off, Asif Ali clips this to long on for one.
This is on a good length and outside the off pole, Babar Azam guides this to third man for a single.

SIX! BANG! Babar Azam crosses 3000 runs in T20I with that maximum! Richard Gleeson bowls this full and outside off, Babar Azam gets under this and deposits the ball over the long on boundary for a huge hit. Gets to the landmark in 81 innings, the joint highest in this format.
This is back of a length and outside off, Asif Ali guides the ball towards third man and takes a run.

FOUR! England have been far too short in this game and runs are flowing feely! This is served outside off and Asif Ali gets a hold of this one and thumps this towards the cow corner boundary for four runs.
Loopy full toss bowled outside off and takes pace off the ball. Asif Ali knocks this to long off and takes a single to keep strike. 5 runs and a wicket from this over.
Bowls this back of a length and outside off, Asif Ali pulls this to the right of deep mid-wicket and takes a couple of runs to get off the mark.
This is bowled a touch fuller and in line with the stumps, Asif Ali looks to work this leg side but gets a leading edge towards cover.
Asif Ali strides out to the middle and he will look to provide the impetus at the end.

OUT! TAKEN! Sam Curran gets his second wicket and sends the dangerous looking Iftikhar Ahmed back to the hut. Sam Curran pulls his length back a bit and bowls a slower delivery again, on middle, Iftikhar Ahmed tries to take him on and goes for the big shot, but he mistimes it in the air badly and towards long on where Harry Brook takes a good catch. The intent from him was good but the execution part was missing. He has done his job though and put his side in a strong position to take it from here.
Commentary.Howout: c Harry Brook b Sam Curran

Commentary.Commentary: A slower delivery, full and on middle, Babar Azam looks for the heave but mistimes it off the inner half towards deep square leg for a run.
Sam Curran bowls a brilliant yorker, on middle, Iftikhar Ahmed digs it out well to the leg side for a single.
Short again and on middle, Iftikhar Ahmed pushes it off his back foot towards long on for a run.

FIFTY FOR AZAM! This is his 27th T20I half-century and 4th against England. This is short and outside off, Babar Azam goes on his back foot and punches it towards sweeper cover for a run. This has been an excellent innings from him and he will now look to take his side to a good total.
A bit short and on middle, Iftikhar Ahmed moves back and nudges it through square leg for a run.

SIX! This is has been sent into the second tier! Adil Rashid flights this up, full and on middle, Iftikhar Ahmed clears his front leg and slog-sweeps it way over the deep mid-wicket fence for a biggie.
Shortish again and on off, Babar Azam cuts it towards sweeper cover for a run.
Short and outside off, Iftikhar Ahmed cuts it towards cover-point where the fielder misfields and allows the batter to get a run.
Another short delivery, on off, Iftikhar Ahmed crunches it towards deep mid-wicket for just a single.
Goes fuller and on middle, Babar Azam tucks it through mid-wicket for a another run.
Richard Gleeson bangs this short and on middle, Iftikhar Ahmed controls his pull shot towards deep square leg for a single.
On a length and on middle, Babar Azam pushes it towards mid on region for one.
FOUR! Lovely shot! This is short of a length and on leg, Babar Azam gently paddles it towards towards the deep square leg region for a boundary.
Full and outside off, Babar Azam reaches for it and drills it towards covers.
Flighted, full and on middle, Babar Azam uses his feet and eases it towards mid-wicket for a single.
Short and on middle, Iftikhar Ahmed moves back and nudges it towards mid-wicket for a run.
Floated, full and on middle, Babar Azam chips it just over the bowler for a single. Adil Rashid is bowling really well here.
Another googly, on middle, turning in, Iftikhar Ahmed looks to flick it away but gets a leading edge towards point for a run.
A googly this time, quicker and full on leg, Iftikhar Ahmed gets cramped and blocks it on the pitch.
SIX! Up, up and away! Adil Rashid tosses it up, full and on middle, Iftikhar Ahmed stays there and deposits it over the long on fence for a huge biggie.
A slower one now, full and on middle, Iftikhar Ahmed works it towards deep mid-wicket for one.
FOUR! David Willey bangs this short and on leg, sits up nicely, Iftikhar Ahmed stays there and pulls it towards the deep backward square leg fence for a boundary.
Willey serves this fuller and on the leg stump line, Babar Azam misses his flick and the ball goes off his pads towards square leg. A leg bye is taken.
Pulls his length back a bit, on off, Iftikhar Ahmed stays back and taps it towards covers for a run.
David Willey pithces it up, on off, Iftikhar Ahmed drives it firmly but straight to the fielder at covers.
WIDE! Willey loses his line and bowls this full an down the leg, Iftikhar Ahmed misses his flick. Wided.
Full and on off, Babar Azam eases it towards long off for a single.

Drinks! Pakistan started off a bit slow but Babar Azam is playing really well here. However, they lost wickets at regular intervals and that restricted their run flow a bit. England will be happy with their effort but know that they need to get Azam out quickly. An exciting session awaits us. David Willey has been handed the ball after the break.
This is a fraction short as well and outside the off stump, Iftikhar Ahmed taps this towards point.
This is flighted full and outside the off pole, Iftikhar Ahmed gets a stride forward and strokes this to the cover fielder.

FOUR! This is short and gets the treatment it requires! Adil Rashid bowls a long hop in line with the stumps, Iftikhar Ahmed uses the depth of the crease and pulls this in the gap at cow corner for a cracking booundary.
Adil Rashid loops this full and just outside off, Babar Azam shimmies down the wicket and clips this to long on for a single.
This is full as well and angling down leg, Iftikhar Ahmed clips this down to long on and takes one.
Adil Rashid floats this one full and in line with the stumps, Babar Azam works this to deep cover for a single.

BEATEN! Sam Curran bowls this on a hard length and outside off, angling away, Iftikhar Ahmed looks to play at it but gets beaten on the outside edge. End of successful over for England. Only 5 runs and a wicket from it.
This is a pacy delivery, on a length and on off, Babar Azam pushes it towards point for a single.
Iftikhar Ahmed comes out to the middle now.

OUT! CAUGHT! Haider Ali showed us glimpses of what is capable of but has departed cheaply here! Sam Curran changes it up and surprises the batter with a short ball outside off, Haider Ali goes for the pull shot but completely mistimes it. The ball goes high towards the deep mid-wicket region. Ben Duckett is placed at the boundary and he does well running forward to take a comfortable catch. Pakistan have lost their third wicket just as it seemed like a partnership was building.
Commentary.Howout: c Ben Duckett b Sam Curran

Commentary.Commentary: Sam Curran continues to bowl full and on the pads, Babar Azam clips this to deep mid-wicket for a single.
Goes full this time and in line with the stumps, Babar Azam knocks this back past the bowler and takes a couple of runs.
Sam Curran begins the over with a short ball just outside off, Haider Ali miscues his pull and lobs it into the vacant region right of mid-wicket. They take a single.
Fires a googly down leg side, Babar Azam goes back in the crease to work this on the leg side but a ball stays low and hits him on his pads.
Flighted delivery bowled full and outside the off stump, Haider Ali works this down to long off for a single.

SIX! This has been dispatched! Adil Rashid bowls this a fraction short and in line with the stumps, Haider Ali charges down the wicket and heaves the ball over deep mid-wicket for a maximum. This should get Haider Ali going.
Loopy delivery bowled full and outside the off pole, Babar Azam strokes this to deep cover for another single.
This is full as well and tossed up outside off, Haider Ali sweeps this to deep square leg and takes a run.
Adil Rashid flights this full and outside off, Babar Azam works this to long on and takes a single.
Adil Rashid comes into the attack now.
Short of a length and around off, Babar Azam drags his pull shot towards deep mid-wicket for a single.
This is back od a length and outside the off pole, Babar Azam taps this towards the point fielder.

Four! This has been punished by Babar Azam! Sam Curran bowls this back of a length and outside the off pole from 'round the wicket. Babar Azam uses his quick hands and pulls this to the deep square leg fence for four more runs.
This is banged in short and outside off, Haider Ali pulls this but does not connect well and the ball goes on the bounce to deep mid-wicket for a single.
Goes over the wicket now and serves this full outside off, Babar Azam knocks this towards mid off and rushes for a quick single.
Sam Curran begins with a good-length delivery from 'round the wicket served outside off. Haider Ali pulls this to deep mid-wicket for a single.
Sam Curran has been introduced into the attack.
This is on a yorker length and heading for the middle stump, Babar Azam gets his bat down in time and digs the ball out down the pitch. Pakistan are 40 for 2 after the Powerplay.
This is short as well and in line with the stumps, Haider Ali pulls this straight at the square leg umpire who gets hit and they take a single.

FOUR! This has been put away in the gap nicely! Richard Gleeson bowls this slightly short and does not get enough height on the ball. Haider Ali swivels and pulls this towards deep backward square leg for four runs.
Bangs this in short and angling down leg, Haider Ali looks to pull but does not connect as the ball goes through to the keeper.
This is a touch fuller and outside the off pole, Babar Azam knocks this towards mid on and takes a quick single. He would have been gone if there was a direct hit.
Richard Gleeson starts the over with a good-length delivery outside off, Babar Azam crunches this on the up towards deep cover for a brace.
Richard Gleeson comes back into the attack. He conceded 10 runs in his first over and picked up a wicket.
Another full delivery and on off, Babar Azam taps it towards mid off and takes a quick single.
Fuller one and on middle, Babar Azam drives it towards mid on.
FOUR! Azam has found his touch! Reece Topley bowls this on a ahrd length and outside off, Babar Azam stays there amd punches it past the diving point fielder for a beautiful boundary.
Short of a length and on middle, Haider Ali pulls it towards deep square leg for a single.
This is pitched up and on off, Haider Ali knocks it back to the bowler where Reece Topley picks it up fakes a throw towards the batter's end.
Full and on middle, Haider Ali works it towards mid-wicket with the inner half.

FOUR! Nice shot! David Willey bowls this a bit full and down the leg, Babar Azam tucks it away nicely towards the deep backward square leg for a boundary. This time Ben Duckett had no chance of stopping that.
This is short and on off, Babar Azam pulls it hard wide of deep square leg where Ben Duckett covers his ground quickly and dives to his left to stop it. Two runs taken!

FOUR! This has been timed beautifully! David Willey goes a fraction full and again attacks the stumps, Babar Azam keeps his head still and flicks this ball to the left of the mid-wicket fielder and finds the boundary for four runs.
David Willey serves this on a good length and in line with the stumps, Haider Ali clips this to deep backward square leg and takes a single to get off the mark.
Haider Ali makes his way out to the crease.

OUT! LBW! England get two in two overs and this time it is Willey. He bowls this on a good length and on off, angling in, Shan Masood moves across to work it to the leg side but misses and gets rapped around his pads. There is an appeal for LBW and up goes the finger. Shan Masood after discussing with Babar Azam opts for the review. The UltraEdge shows no bat involved. Ball Tracking shows three reds and the original decision remains. Pakistan lose another and England are on top at the moment.
David Willey bowls this on a good length and just outside off, Babar Azam knocks this straight past the umpire and they take a single as long off comes and cuts the ball off.
This is on a good length and outside off, Shan Masood taps this towards short cover. 9 runs and a wicket from this over.
Shan Masood makes his way out to the middle at number 3.

OUT! TAKEN! Richard Gleeson strikes in his very first over and sends the debutant back to the hut. He follows the batter and bowls this short of a length and on leg, Mohammad Haris moves across to cut it over short third man, but it is too close to his body and the ball loops up off the top half of the bat towards short third man where Adil Rashid takes a comfortable catch. Haris goes for a cheap score on his debut and Pakistan lose their first.
Commentary.Howout: c Adil Rashid b Richard Gleeson

Commentary.Commentary: This is on a hard length and on middle, Babar Azam tucks it towards deep square  leg for one.
Short of a length again and on off, Mohammad Haris knocks it with his gloves to the leg side for a run.

SIX! Mohammad Haris gets off the mark in T20Is in some style! Richard Gleeson bowls a short of a length delivery, on off, Mohammad Haris stays there and smokes it over the long off fence for a biggie.
This is on a good length and on middle, Babar Azam strokes it towards mid on for a quick single.
Short of a length and on middle, Babar Azam mistimes his pull shot towards mid on for a single. The ball is not coming on to the bat and the batters are faling to time the ball.
Pulls his length back a bit and on off, Babar Azam stays there and punches it towards mid off.
Willey serves this full and on the leg stump line, Babar Azam tucks it towards the vacant mid-wicket region for a brace.
Willey bowls this on a length and on off, sticks to the surface a bit, Babar Azam strokes it towards short covers.
A bit fuller this time, on middle, Babar Azam goes for the drive but gets an inside edge towards short fine leg.
David Willey starts with a good-length delivery, on off, Babar Azam knocks it towards mid off.
David Willey to share the attack with Reece Topley.
A slower one now, on a length and on off, Mohammad Haris pushes it towards point. Only 2 runs from the first over then!
Four dots on the trot! Mohammad Haris move across way outside off, Reece Topley follows him and bowls a hard-length delivery, outside off, Haris goes for the scoop but misses.
Fuller one, on off, Mohammad Haris uses his feet and tries to heave it but mistimes it back to the bowler.
On a length and on middle, Mohammad Haris blocks it back to the bowler.
Goes fuller this time, on middle, swinging in, Mohammad Haris covers the line and drives it towards mid on.
This is short of a length and on middle, Babar Azam pulls it towards deep square leg for a single.
Reece Topley loses his line and starts with a full delivery down the leg side. Babar Azam misses his flick. It is callled a wide. Pakistan are underway!

We are all set for the start of the game! The two umpires are walking out to the middle followed by the England players. We will see a new opening pair for Pakistan with Mohammad Rizwan not playing and it will be his replacement Mohammad Haris (On Debut) who will be partnering Babar Azam. Reece Topley to start proceedings with the ball. Let's play...

Pakistan (Playing XI) - Babar Azam (C), Mohammad Haris (WK) (In for Mohammad Rizwan & On Debut), Shan Masood, Iftikhar Ahmed, Shadab Khan, Haider Ali, Asif Ali, Mohammad Nawaz, Aamer Jamal, Mohammad Wasim, Shahnawaz Dahani (In for Haris Rauf).

England (Playing XI) - Philip Salt (WK), Alex Hales, Dawid Malan, Ben Duckett, Harry Brook, Moeen Ali (C), Sam Curran, David Willey, Adil Rashid, Reece Topley (In for Chris Woakes), Richard Gleeson (In for Mark Wood)..
TOSS - England have won the toss and they have decided to BOWL first.
The Pakistan camp have already announced that Mohammad Haris will be making his T20I debut in this game.
